QUAD 303 · POWER AMPLIFIER

Restoring your Quad 303

The Quad 303 is a transistor power amplifier. It drives your loudspeakers and is usually paired with the Quad 33 preamplifier.

This guide is new. Nobody has checked its parts list against a real Quad 303 yet, so treat it as a starting point.

Before anything else: stay safe

This power amplifier plugs into the mains. Parts inside can still give you a dangerous shock after it is unplugged.

If you are new to electronics, don't open it. You can do everything on this page from the outside. A qualified technician does the work inside.

Four steps

1

Write down a few details

You can find all of these from the outside.

  • The serial number. It decides which adjuster part your technician needs.
  • Your loudspeakers. Old Quad electrostatic speakers made before serial 16800 need a small change before use with a 303.
  • Your preamplifier.
  • Anything already done to it, such as an earlier repair.
2

Talk it through with an AI assistant

An AI assistant with the Quad Agent guide checks your details against Quad's own documents and tells you what applies to your Quad 303. It asks questions first and never guesses part values.

Copy this into your AI assistant:

Read quad-upgrade/SKILL.md and follow it to help me restore my Quad 303. Start by helping me identify it from the outside.

It needs the guide files first. Download the guide and add it to your assistant, or give it the quad-upgrade folder.

3

Choose what you want done

The recap

The 303's big capacitors dry out with age. DADA says this makes it sound as if it is "behind a curtain", with weaker bass and less punch. A recap replaces the capacitors and the small adjusters. Then a technician sets the amplifier up again with a meter.

Optional extras

These change how the Quad 303 behaves. You don't need any of them.

  • Lower sensitivity. Makes the 303 need a stronger signal, which can suit modern sources. Only worth doing if your preamp can drive it.
  • LED mains light. Replaces the little neon lamp if it no longer lights.
4

Take it to a technician

Send them the link to this page. Everything they need is in the section below: the parts list, Quad's service documents and the upgrade guides.

Ask them to check the parts against your actual Quad 303 before ordering. Quad changed things during production, and earlier owners may have too.

Good to know

  • Setting up after the recap is done with the amplifier switched on. That is always a job for a technician.
  • DADA advises against reworking very old driver boards and offers new replacement boards instead. Your technician can tell which you have.
  • The two sources give different figures for the final adjustment. Both are listed for your technician.
